source.title: Updates to the WCA Dues System Policy (October 2022)
source.content:
The WCA Financial Committee (WFC) has issued an update to the WCA Dues System Policy that will be applicable to all competitions announced on and after October 25, 2022. The changes include an increase in the percentage of the registration fee per competitor that is owed as a due from each WCA competition and increases the base level of dues per competitor for countries that fall in Bands 4 and 5. 

This change will provide significant funding for the growth of the WCA, and to start working on projects that are currently in the planning stages. For the short term, funding will be going towards improvements to WCA Software.
<!-- break -->
A full list of changes can be found on the GitHub pull request [here](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/313/files) and [here](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/pull/7234). 

The full updated Dues document can be found [here](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Dues%20System.pdf).

Please contact the WFC ([finance@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:finance@worldcubeassociation.org)) with any questions.

translation.title: 《WCA 会费制度政策》更新（2022 年 10 月）
translation.content:
WCA 财务委员会（WFC）已更新《WCA 会费制度政策》，适用于 2022 年 10 月 25 日及之后公布的全部比赛。本次调整提高了各场 WCA 比赛按每位选手报名费计算的会费比例，也提高了第 4、5 档国家每位选手的会费基准金额。

这一调整将为 WCA 的发展提供更多资金，并支持启动目前尚在筹备中的项目。短期内，资金将用于改善 WCA 软件。

<!-- break -->

完整改动列表见 GitHub 上的[这份拉取请求](https://github.com/thewca/wca-documents/pull/313/files)和[这份拉取请求](https://github.com/thewca/worldcubeassociation.org/pull/7234)。

更新后的会费政策全文见[此处](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/policies/external/Dues%20System.pdf)。

如有疑问，请联系 WFC（[finance@worldcubeassociation.org](mailto:finance@worldcubeassociation.org)）。
